steps.sql:
SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE t1 MATCH 'one' 
  ORDER BY rank(matchinfo(t1), 1.0, 1.0) DESC, rowid
steps.expect:
{one two} one
  {one two} three
  {one two} two

steps.sql:
SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE t1 MATCH 'two' 
  ORDER BY rank(matchinfo(t1), 1.0, 1.0) DESC, rowid
steps.expect:
{one two} two
  {one two} one
  {one two} three

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM t1 ORDER BY rank(matchinfo(t1), 1.0, 1.0) DESC, rowid
steps.expect: 1 {invalid matchinfo blob passed to function rank()}

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM t1 ORDER BY rank(x'0000000000000000') DESC, rowid
steps.expect: 0 {{one two} one {one two} three {one two} two}

steps.sql: SELECT * FROM t1 ORDER BY rank(x'0000000100000001') DESC, rowid
steps.expect: 1 {invalid matchinfo blob passed to function rank()}
